objective.text: Queue one delivery job for each recipient and channel when the notification is queued.

difficulty.rationale: Count delivery work units rather than treating the whole recipient collection as one job.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A ShouldQueue notification is sent to three recipients. via() returns ["mail","database"] for each. No channels are suppressed. How many queued notification delivery jobs are created?

options.rationale: Queueing creates work for each recipient/channel pair: three recipients times two channels.
The complete recipient/channel matrix is not one ordinary queued notification job.
options.misconception: The complete recipient/channel matrix is not one ordinary queued notification job.

options.rationale: Counting only recipients ignores their two selected delivery channels.
options.misconception: Counting only recipients ignores their two selected delivery channels.

options.rationale: Counting only channels ignores separate jobs for the three recipients.
options.misconception: Counting only channels ignores separate jobs for the three recipients.
